The '''Data Center''' was a building that housed a major database of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] located on the surface levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
In the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] was able to slice false identity and history backing [[Kell Bircher]]'s insertion in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]]. Two months after the Battle of [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and a squad of [[Elite stormtrooper (Galactic Empire)|elite stormtroopers]], along with [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Nanda (ensign)|Nanda]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader's [[Aide/Legends|aide]], visited the Center to find how the information concerning Bircher was sliced into the data. During this operation, Vader ordered the Center's [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] [[Death/Legends|shot]] and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] an attached [[Major/Legends|major]] for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="SW13 (1)" />

==Layout==
The Data Center was an enormous monolith-like structure that was made of a streamlined [[Color/Legends|turquoise]] material.<ref name="SW13 (1)" />
